tool_schemas.name: rewrite_coding_prompt
tool_schemas.description: Creates a coding-prompt rewrite request from the provided source_prompt, runs the rewrite job, persists the generated rewrite variant(s) along with model/runtime metadata, and returns the completed result (or the current job status if timeout_ms elapses before completion). If client_request_id is provided, the request is treated as idempotent and the same stored result is returned for repeats rather than creating a new job. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when source_prompt is empty/invalid, variants or timeout_ms are not valid integers or are out of allowed range, or request_context is not an object; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when credentials or permissions are missing, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when usage limits are reached, and CONFLICT when client_request_id is reused with different request content.

source_prompt.description: The original coding prompt text to be rewritten.

source_language_hint.description: Optional hint for the source prompt language (e.g., 'python', 'javascript').

request_context.description: Optional structured context to guide the rewrite (free-form JSON object).

variants.description: Number of rewrite variants to generate.

timeout_ms.description: Optional maximum time to wait for the rewrite job to finish before returning.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity derived from the presented API key, including granted scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption; refuses with an auth error if the key is missing, invalid, disabled, or revoked.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

tool_schemas.name: list_rewrite_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored rewrite requests visible to the caller (scoped to the authenticated API key), with filtering and pagination; refuses requests that are unauthenticated or use a disabled/revoked key.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

client_request_id.description: Optional exact-match filter for client-provided idempotency key.

created_after.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp; return requests created after this time.

created_before.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp; return requests created before this time.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_rewrite_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single rewrite request by id (including its current status and error details if any); refuses if not found or not accessible under the caller's API key.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

include_outputs.description: If true, include associated rewrite outputs in the response.

include_model_runs.description: If true, include associated model run records in the response.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_rewrite_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running rewrite request by transitioning its status to cancelled; refuses if the request is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled) or not accessible under the caller's API key.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason for audit/diagnostics.

tool_schemas.name: list_rewrite_outputs
tool_schemas.description: Lists rewrite outputs for a given rewrite request (or across requests) with pagination; refuses if the referenced request is not accessible under the caller's API key.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

rewrite_request_id.description: Optional rewrite request id to scope outputs to a single request.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: update_rewrite_output_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a rewrite output through its lifecycle (generated→redacted/deleted, redacted→deleted); refuses invalid transitions or attempts to modify a deleted output, and refuses if the output is not accessible under the caller's API key.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

status.description: New status to apply; must be a valid lifecycle transition from the current status.

redaction_reason.description: Optional reason stored for audit/diagnostics when setting status to redacted.

metadata.name: Coding Prompt Engineer
metadata.description: This backend stores coding prompt rewrite requests and their generated rewrites, including the model/runtime metadata used to produce them. The main workflow is: accept a rewrite request, execute a rewrite job, persist the output, and track status plus basic observability for API usage. Repository:
